objects.original: Raw Tropp Proposition3.1 concerns a finite square self-adjoint random matrix, complex by §2.1. The selected source item expressly specializes to finite nonempty real matrices.
objects.reconstructed: The decoder reconstructs a real n×n random matrix with finite nonempty index, ordinary matrix powers/exponential and unnormalized trace, and real spectral supremum Λ(A).
objects.evidence: Phase1 frozen source reconstruction, Tropp pp7–10; decoder output1 Objects/Domains; current P lines23–60. The disclosed real carrier is retained. No full-complex equivalence is claimed.

domains.original: All real thresholds; positive real Laplace parameters. Selected public source item discloses a nonnegative scalar extended-expectation completion, whereas raw Tropp only states expectation under standing regularity and warns in §3.1 about MGF nonexistence.
domains.reconstructed: The decoder puts t∈ℝ, s∈(0,∞), X on a probability experiment, and comparison in [0,∞]. It reconstructs the nonnegative integral and does not assume it finite.
domains.evidence: Decoder output1 Domains/Conclusion explicitly allows +∞; current P uses subtype 0<s and lintegral. Current lesson assumptions state this is a domain completion and not a source definition of ENNReal or an extended matrix expectation.

quantifiers.original: For every allowed random matrix and every real t, the bound is the infimum over all positive real parameters, with no optimizer assertion.
quantifiers.reconstructed: The decoder states every carrier/measure/index/X/assumption witness and every real t, and the full infimum over all s>0 without attainment.
quantifiers.evidence: Tropp Prop3.1 statement and p10 final sentence; decoder output1 Quantifiers and Constant-dependencies; P lines55–67. No positivity condition on t or restricted sequence of s is introduced.

conclusion.original: Largest algebraic eigenvalue upper-tail at inclusive threshold is ≤inf_{s>0} exp(-st) times expected unnormalized trace exponential, in the advertised real/scalar-completed sense.
conclusion.reconstructed: The decoder displays μ{t≤Λ(X)}≤inf_{s>0} exp(-st)∫⁺max{tr(exp(sX)),0}; it explains ofReal and identifies Λ with the algebraic maximum on the AE symmetric domain.
conclusion.evidence: Source pointwise trace positivity makes nonnegative-part integral equal to the intended scalar completed expectation AE. Decoder output1 Conclusion; P lines63–67 and AE comparison/Markov body. The strictly positive finite coefficient causes no 0·∞ ambiguity.

scopes.original: All events/expectations use the same probability law; matrix exponential and ordinary trace have spectral meanings; λmax has no absolute value and is not the operator norm. Source self-adjointness may be AE.
scopes.reconstructed: Decoder retains one μ, literal sSup on exceptional points, matrix multiplication in all powers, unnormalized trace, inclusive event, integral-before-infimum order and AE-domain interpretation.
scopes.evidence: Decoder output1 Objects/Scopes; phase1 standard definitions; P entire module. The null exceptional self-adjoint set cannot change event measure. No measurable eigenbasis premise or general non-Hermitian largest-eigenvalue claim is inferred.

constant_dependencies.original: The probability bridge has no dimension prefactor or extra universal constant; dimension enters through the unnormalized trace.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: Decoder states there is no selected constant, no explicit added dimension factor and no minimizer, while an approximately optimizing s can depend on t and the law/dimension.
constant_dependencies.evidence: Tropp Prop3.1 has no d prefactor; decoder output1 Constant-dependencies; P RHS has only exp(-st) and trace-exponential integral. Independent-sum MGF/variance/Bernstein constants are outside this statement.

scope_verdict.accepted_scope: Selected finite nonempty real matrix specialization with AE regularity and disclosed nonnegative scalar extended-expectation completion of the Laplace probability bridge.
not_accepted_as: Literal identity with the full complex Tropp Proposition3.1
A claim that Tropp defines ENNReal or that every matrix Bochner MGF exists
Independent-sum MGF/master-tail/Bernstein or a two-sided operator-norm result

raw_source_scope_deltas.detail: Raw source convention is complex self-adjoint; selected formal carrier is real.
The formal nonnegative scalar expectation may be infinite; raw source regularity/MGF caveat is retained without attributing ENNReal to the author.
